title: Lackawanna man convicted by a federal jury of attempting to force his sister to marry in Yemen going to prison
summary: U.S. Attorney Michael DiGiacomo announced today that Adham Abughanem, 29, of Lackawanna, NY, who was convicted following a federal jury trial of conspiracy to kidnap a person in a foreign country and kidnapping conspiracy, was sentenced to serve 10 years in prison by U.S. District Judge John L. Sinatra, Jr.
